ai_summary: Arman Financial Services Limited's wholly-owned subsidiary, Namra Finance Limited, has strategically re-appointed Mr. Chandramouli Akkiraju as Chief Business Officer, effective October 16, 2026. This is a material positive impact, as Mr. Akkiraju previously served as Namra's COO from 2017-2023, during which he oversaw a significant increase in microfinance AUM from Rs. 90 crore to Rs. 1,500 crore. His proven track record and extensive experience are expected to drive continued business growth and expansion, with no discernible red flags identified in this appointment.
